utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — we’re still on for this afternoon, unless you’ve heard any updates. Did you want to start with the roof leak and the broken gate?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — I haven’t heard any updates. Let’s start with the roof leak and the broken gate, and I’ll double-check the rest before we move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can sort and label the donated items. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks Sam — start with the donated items, and I’ll handle the sign-up sheets once those are sorted.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll get started on the donated items now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep everyone posted and pass along any changes on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm we’re still on for today, and send the exact time when you know it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes — we’re still on for today, and I’ll send the exact time as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—what’s the easiest way you’d like me to share it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — you can tell folks I’m confirming the start time and exact spot now, and I’ll share it as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll let people know you’re confirming the start time and exact spot, and I’ll pass along the details as soon as you send them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on the exact spot for the repair drive—can you confirm where it’s set up today?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s set for Sunday at the community center — I’m keeping the supply list updated, too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll note the updated supply list too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, yeah, I think we’re still on for the repair drive today — I’m just a little fuzzy on the exact time. Want me to check and make sure?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, please check the time — I’ll keep spreading the word in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I’ll check the time now and let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo — I’ll stick to the plan and wait for an update. If anything changes at the repair drive, let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do, Eli — I’ll keep you posted right away if anything changes at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll stay ready and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it sounds like they’re getting a nice little crowd together already. I’ll swing by later and let you know if Pia needs anything else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I just want to make sure we’ve got the timing and tools lined up so Saturday morning stays manageable.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I heard they’re still taking hand tools, paint, and unopened supplies at the community center parking lot by the library. I’ll stop by later and check if they need anything else for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — just send me the spot and I’ll head over to help with the sign-up sheets.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’ll send the spot over now — the sign-up sheets are the next thing I need handled.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — send me the spot and I’ll head over right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep organizing here; could you set the sign-in sheet and materials by the front table?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll put the sign-in sheet and materials by the front table now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — that’s perfect. I’m going to finish setting up the rest here, and then we’ll be ready to start.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m back from errands now — did anything change with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard of any changes yet, but I’ll pass along anything new if I do. If someone needs help or has a repair need, I’ll send them Rosa’s way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — thanks, Nell. I’ll keep an eye out too and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center now, and I’d love your help with one of the sign-up tasks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help, Rosa — I can take a sign-up task and bring along a few tools too if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Gus — please handle the sign-up list, and I’ll send you the repair drive details for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Faye — I’ll send the Sunday community center location and start time as soon as I have them, along with a simple sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out for the details and work around pickup once you send them over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll send the exact location and start time soon, and I’ll include the sign-up list too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m headed to the community garage on Maple Street now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can still help — what’s left for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — can you grab the donated tools and start sorting them? After that, hand out the repair sign-up sheets.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for the reminder. Please send me the list, and I’ll help sort donations or whatever else still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll send over the list and can help sort the donations too. Just let me know if you want me to grab tools or spare parts as well.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Uli — take your time, and just let me know when you’re ready for the tools. I can bring them by after your last drop-off trip.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate that. I’ll let you know as soon as I’m done with the drop-off trip.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Uli — just give me a shout when you’re back, and I’ll bring the tools by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning still works for me, as long as we’ve got the tool list and a rough time estimate for the roof and gate.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Pia. I’ll wait for Hana’s update on the tool list and timing, then we’ll keep the repair drive on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — once Hana sends the tool list and timing, I can plan the morning around it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal — could you help sort and label the donated items for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I can help sort and label them. I’m also keeping track of the repair drive location, so let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks, Opal — that’s a big help. I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — that’s super helpful. I’ll pass that along and keep an ear out if I hear of anyone who needs to drop something off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Glad to help — I’ll keep spreading the word and send more neighbors over to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still catching up, so any details you can share would really help. I’ll pass them along to the neighbors I’ve heard from.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — I’m keeping the supply list updated, so if you spot any tools or spare parts, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I spot anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. I’ll keep the list current and note anything we still need for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — I’d still like to start with the roof leak and the broken gate. Have you heard any updates on timing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t heard a firm timing update yet, but I can help keep asking and pass along anything I learn. If you want, I can also help spread the word about the roof leak and gate fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that’d help. Please keep asking about timing, and go ahead and spread the word about the roof leak and the broken gate.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Hana — could you help set out the sign-in sheet and materials? I’m organizing the rest now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I can set out the sign-in sheet and materials once I’ve double-checked the repair drive details. If you send me the exact setup, I’ll get right on it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Hana — please put the sign-in sheet at the entrance table and lay out the materials beside it once you’ve checked the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Noah — if you can swing by the community center parking lot by the library, they’re still taking hand tools, paint, and unopened supplies. I’ll check in later and let you know if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I can swing by the community center parking lot by the library with some hand tools and unopened supplies. I’ll check back later for any updates.
